audioSetup: Funktion-One Resolution 2, 4x F118 Sub, Pioneer CDJ-3000 + Allen & Heath Xone:96

notes.it: Club night underground. Flusso continuo da Tech House incalzante a 127 BPM fino alle sonorità più scure e serrate dell'Acid Techno stile Drumcode.
notes.en: Underground club night. Seamless progression from driving 127 BPM Tech House into the darker, relentless textures of Drumcode-style Acid Techno.
